column3: What is the winning percentage of teams with 10 wickets in hand at the start of the last 10 overs in T20 matches?
column4:
WITH ChaseMatches AS (
    SELECT r.fixture_id, r.score, r.wickets,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN b.ball > (CAST(r.overs AS FLOAT) * 6 - 60) AND r.wickets = 0 THEN 1 END) AS last_10_overs_with_10_wickets
    FROM history2.fixtures__runs r
    JOIN history2.fixtures__balls b ON r.fixture_id = b.fixture_id
    WHERE r.inning = 2 
      AND b.scoreboard = 'S2'
    GROUP BY r.fixture_id, r.score, r.wickets
),
MatchResults AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_chases,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.score > (SELECT TOP 1 r1.score FROM history2.fixtures__runs r1 WHERE r1.fixture_id = c.fixture_id AND r1.inning = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_chases
    FROM ChaseMatches c
    WHERE c.last_10_overs_with_10_wickets > 0
)
SELECT 
    CAST(m.successful_chases AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(m.total_chases, 0) * 100 AS winning_percentage
FROM MatchResults m;

column3: How many wickets has Pat Cummins taken in the last 5 matches he has played?
column4:
SELECT COUNT(bowl.wickets) AS total_wickets
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT TOP 5 b.fixture_id
    FROM history2.fixtures__balls b
    WHERE b.bowler__fullname = 'Pat Cummins'
    ORDER BY b.fixture_id DESC
) AS last_matches
JOIN history2.fixtures__bowling bowl ON last_matches.fixture_id = bowl.fixture_id
GROUP BY bowl.fixture_id;

column3: What is the highest successful chase achieved by Kolkata Knight Riders in the IPL history?
column4:
SELECT MAX(r.score) AS highest_successful_chase
FROM history2.fixtures__runs r
WHERE r.inning = 2 AND r.score > (
    SELECT TOP 1 score
    FROM history2.fixtures__runs
    WHERE fixture_id = r.fixture_id AND inning = 1
) AND r.team_id = (
    SELECT TOP 1 team_id
    FROM history2.fixtures__balls b
    WHERE scoreboard = 'S2' AND b.team__name = 'Kolkata Knight Riders'
)

column3: What percentage of runs in this match have been scored in boundaries by both batsmen combined?
column4:
WITH boundary_runs AS (
    SELECT fixture_id, SUM(score__runs) AS total_boundary_runs
    FROM history2.fixtures__balls
    WHERE scoreboard = 'S2' AND (score__four = 1 OR score__six = 1)
    GROUP BY fixture_id
),
total_runs AS (
    SELECT fixture_id, SUM(score__runs) AS total_runs
    FROM history2.fixtures__balls
    WHERE scoreboard = 'S2'
    GROUP BY fixture_id
)
SELECT tr.fixture_id,
       CASE
           WHEN tr.total_runs = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE CAST(br.total_boundary_runs AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(tr.total_runs AS FLOAT), 0) * 100
       END AS boundary_percentage
FROM total_runs tr
JOIN boundary_runs br ON tr.fixture_id = br.fixture_id;
